paraphrase: OPEN frontier premise (coverage, attribution deferred): each of the two uses of 'God' on the designated root route (the fully described principle is God; whatever is God has the classical attributes) is read as what the name signifies (GOD_1, NominalGod: the full q.13 a.8 ad 2 description with the quarta via's cause of every perfection), the Summa's God parameter of the older stage-1 routes (GOD_2), what is called God in usage (GOD_3, CalledGod) or the God of classical theism (GOD_4, Signature.IsGod), selected by the route's reading, and the use's predicate is exactly that sense's predicate. Scott's and Goedel's GodLike are not listed: they are world-indexed predicates over a positivity constant, and a rival who reads the route's God that way denies this premise.
label: Each use of 'God' on the designated root route is GOD_1, GOD_2, GOD_3 or GOD_4
